selection_purpose: Generate fresh real feedback after the documented Holdout convergence; this is a pre-outcome case-selection action and does not seek or imply a result.

selection_rationale.pre_outcome_structure: A Chinese renewable-energy manufacturing cluster with a broad, decision-relevant pre-outcome structure in which capacity and shipment-volume expansion can diverge from unit economics and pricing, working-capital absorption, capital-spending and debt requirements, and permanent-loss protection.
selection_rationale.learning_value: The structure can produce real feedback on whether a blind assessment keeps scale, margin, cash absorption, funding needs, and permanent-loss treatment separate rather than treating capacity growth as a sufficient conclusion.
selection_rationale.selection_rule: Select one previously unseen company cluster that satisfies the required mechanism class and has an original FY2021-FY2023 CNINFO annual-report packet publicly available before the cutoff.
selection_rationale.result_independence: No outcome, price, return, analyst, or FY2024 information was used to choose this candidate.

source_metadata.packet_cleanliness_rule: Each selected item is the original full annual-report disclosure for one required fiscal year; report summaries and the FY2022 revision are excluded.

firewall_and_role_separation.selection_role: This selector may inspect only curriculum identity/track/company-cluster fields and official CNINFO metadata needed to identify the pre-cutoff original annual-report packet.
firewall_and_role_separation.blind_investigator_role: A subsequent blind investigator may use only the selected FY2021-FY2023 packet and other separately authorized pre-cutoff evidence to form and freeze an ex-ante judgment.
firewall_and_role_separation.outcome_role: A separate outcome operator may acquire and assess post-cutoff evidence only after the blind judgment is frozen; that operator must not influence candidate selection or pre-outcome reasoning.
firewall_and_role_separation.feedback_role: A separate feedback integrator may compare the frozen judgment with outcome evidence after outcome acquisition, focusing on mechanism calibration rather than score-seeking.
